purpose: Evidence review for a garden planner; short excerpts and source locators only.

evidencePolicy.communityVerified: Original IGN preview and two independent demo gameplay transcripts corroborate the named crop and observed rules; they are not official published crop values.
evidencePolicy.official: Only developer-authored Steam announcement text is labelled official.
evidencePolicy.unknown: Fields without a directly supported value remain null. Unknown growth duration must not generate a ready day.
evidencePolicy.excerptLimit: At most 25 quoted words per original source, cumulatively across this archive; no complete video transcript is retained.
evidencePolicy.excluded: No wiki inference, soundtrack-title inference, installed demo, or guessed numeric crop data.
